description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Thunderblust
When Thunderblust dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Thunderblust enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thunderblust
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
